official_definition: Programmers and software development professionals examine software requirements, and design, develop, test and maintain software programs, computer games and websites.
tasks: examines operational requirements and designs software solutions
writes code in computer languages according to functional specifications
tests software solutions to identify and correct bugs
maintains and updates existing software programs and code libraries
entry_qualifications: Degree or equivalent in computer science or related discipline; vendor certifications or relevant technical experience.

official_definition: Cyber security professionals design, implement and monitor cyber security measures to protect computer networks and systems from unauthorized access, cyber attacks and data breaches.
tasks: analyzes security risks and vulnerabilities in digital infrastructure
implements firewall rules, intrusion detection systems, and encryption standards
monitors network traffic for security breaches and investigates incidents
conducts penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
entry_qualifications: Degree in cyber security, computer science, or equivalent professional qualifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+).

official_definition: IT quality and testing professionals examine systems and software to ensure quality, performance and adherence to engineering standards through automated and manual test execution.
tasks: develops test scripts, automated testing suites and test scenarios
executes regression, integration, load, and performance tests
logs, tracks, and verifies resolutions of identified software defects
enforces software quality assurance standards across the SDLC
entry_qualifications: Degree in computing or relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., ISTQB certification).

occupation_title: IT business analysts, architects and systems designers
official_definition: IT business analysts, architects and systems designers examine operational procedures, specify system requirements and formulate technical architectures for organizational IT systems.
tasks: interviews stakeholders to identify operational pain points and functional requirements
formulates logical and physical system designs and enterprise architectures
produces UML diagrams, data models, and API specifications
evaluates feasibility and cost-benefit of alternative technological solutions
entry_qualifications: Degree in computer science, business information systems, or equivalent industry experience.

official_definition: IT network professionals plan, coordinate, install, maintain, and support telecommunications and computer network hardware, routers, switches, and software.
tasks: plans network capacity, topologies, and routing protocols
configures network switches, firewalls, routers, and virtual subnets
diagnoses network outages, packet loss, and latency issues
manages network monitoring and performance optimization tools
entry_qualifications: Degree in networking, telecommunications, or vendor credentials (CCNA, CCNP, Network+).

official_definition: IT project managers plan, organize, and direct computer and information technology projects, managing delivery schedules, budgets, technical dependencies, and teams.
tasks: defines project scope, milestones, deliverables, and resource plans
manages technical risks, dependency tracks, and budget allocations
coordinates multidisciplinary development and engineering teams
reports progress and escalations to senior steering committees
entry_qualifications: Degree level qualification with project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master).

occupation_title: Database administrators and web content technicians
official_definition: Database administrators and web content technicians maintain, coordinate and operate database systems, and publish content to digital channels.
tasks: maintains database schemas, transactional integrity, and data security
performs database performance tuning, indexing, and backup procedures
controls access permissions and privileges across databases
entry_qualifications: Vocational diploma, foundation degree, or relevant vendor certifications (Oracle, Microsoft, AWS).

official_definition: Data analysts inspect, cleanse, transform, and model data using analytical and statistical tools to discover useful information and support business intelligence.
tasks: extracts and cleans structured data from organizational databases
builds dashboards and automated reporting visualizations in BI tools
performs statistical trend analysis and KPI tracking
interprets data trends to inform commercial decision-making
entry_qualifications: Degree or diploma in mathematics, statistics, computing, or business analytics.

official_definition: Research, design, and develop computer and network software or specialized utility programs. Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. Update software or enhance existing software capabilities.
tasks: develop and direct software system testing and validation procedures
modify existing software to correct errors or improve its performance
analyze user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design
design or customize software for client use with the aim of optimizing operational efficiency
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer and information technology or related field.

official_definition: Develop and implement algorithms and statistical models that enable computers to learn from data. Analyze large volumes of data to discover patterns, trends, and actionable insights. May specialize in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, or predictive modeling.
tasks: apply machine learning algorithms and statistical models to solve complex business problems
clean, organize, and transform large unstructured and structured datasets
design experiments, validate hypotheses, and evaluate model performance metrics
communicate analytical findings and predictions through visual dashboards and executive reports
entry_qualifications: Master's degree or Bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, statistics, or mathematics.

occupation_title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
official_definition: Participate in software design reviews to provide input on functional requirements, product designs, schedules, or potential problems. Test system modifications to prepare for implementation. Document software defects using a bug tracking system and report defects to software developers.
tasks: develop automated and manual test scripts to test software applications
conduct software system testing, performance testing, and regression testing
document software defects and verify fixes in issue tracking systems
evaluate software design and user requirements against quality standards
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field.

official_definition: Plan, implement, upgrade, or monitor security measures for the protection of computer networks and information. May ensure appropriate security controls are in place that will safeguard digital files and vital electronic infrastructure. May respond to computer security breaches and viruses.
tasks: monitor organizational networks for security breaches and investigate violations
install and use software such as firewalls and data encryption programs
prepare reports that document security breaches and the extent of the damage caused
conduct penetration testing and simulate cyber attacks to identify vulnerabilities
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer and information technology, cybersecurity, or engineering.

official_definition: Administer, test, and implement computer databases, applying knowledge of database management systems. Coordinate changes to computer databases. May plan, coordinate, and implement security measures to safeguard computer databases.
tasks: identify user needs to create and administer databases
ensure that database operations comply with security standards
backup and restore data to prevent data loss
test database programs and evaluate performance for query optimization
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in management information systems, computer science, or equivalent.

official_definition: Install, configure, and maintain an organization's local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN), data communications network, operating systems, and physical and virtual servers.
tasks: maintain and administer computer networks and related computing environments
perform data backups and disaster recovery operations
diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, or other network and system problems
plan, coordinate, and implement network security measures
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer networking, information science, or postsecondary certificate.

official_definition: Analyze science, engineering, business, and other data processing problems to implement and improve computer systems. Analyze user requirements, procedures, and problems to automate or improve existing systems and review computer system capabilities, workflow, and scheduling limitations.
tasks: consult with managers to determine the role of the IT system in an organization
research emerging technologies to decide if installing them can increase efficiency
prepare an analysis of costs and benefits so that management can decide on systems
devise ways to add new functionality to existing computer systems
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer and information technology, business information, or related field.

official_definition: Designs, constructs, tests, modifies, debugs, and maintains computer software applications, operating systems, and distributed computing solutions according to specified quality standards and technical specifications.
tasks: researches, consults, and analyzes system program needs
identifies technical limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes
writes, tests and updates code according to agreed specifications and standards
coordinates with database administrators and systems architects to integrate solutions
entry_qualifications: Bachelor degree or higher qualification (AQF Level 7 or higher) or at least five years of relevant experience.

official_definition: Extracts insights from large-scale structured and unstructured data using advanced mathematical, statistical, machine learning, and data visualization techniques.
tasks: formulates statistical hypotheses and designs experimental testing frameworks
engineers features and builds predictive machine learning models
evaluates statistical validity and accuracy of algorithmic outputs
communicates findings through data visualization and technical reports
entry_qualifications: Bachelor degree or higher in data science, mathematics, statistics, or computing.

official_definition: Establishes, manages, and administers an organization's ICT security policy and procedures to protect against unauthorized access, integrity violations, and system vulnerabilities.
tasks: assesses security risks and analyzes vulnerabilities across ICT environments
implements firewalls, access control lists, and encryption protocols
responds to cyber security breaches, incidents, and malware intrusions
audits adherence to national and organizational information security policies
entry_qualifications: Bachelor degree or higher in computing, cyber security, or equivalent professional credentials.

official_definition: Specifies, designs, and executes software test cases, plans, and automated scripts to verify that software operates accurately and adheres to defined quality requirements.
tasks: creates and executes automated and manual test scripts
records and reports defect details in defect tracking systems
verifies fixes and performs regression testing across build cycles
validates user experience and functional acceptance criteria
entry_qualifications: Bachelor degree or AQF Associate Degree / Advanced Diploma with relevant testing experience.

official_definition: Researches, designs, writes, and modifies computer software, applications, and operating systems according to technical requirements.
tasks: analyzes software requirements and designs system architecture
develops program code using structured programming languages
tests and verifies software performance against functional specs
maintains documentation and version histories of codebases
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or equivalent polytechnic diploma.

official_definition: Develops, optimizes, and implements artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, deep learning models, and automated inference pipelines for production applications.
tasks: develops neural networks, computer vision models, and NLP architectures
optimizes model inference latency and manages distributed compute clusters
deploys models into cloud and edge production environments
monitors model performance and prevents data and concept drift
entry_qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in artificial intelligence, computer science, or data science.

official_definition: Analyzes complex datasets to extract insights, uncover patterns, and build predictive statistical models that solve strategic operational and business challenges.
tasks: collects and synthesizes data from disparate enterprise systems
applies advanced statistical analysis and predictive modeling
interprets data trends to advise management on business strategy
creates analytical dashboards and data storytelling presentations
entry_qualifications: Degree in data science, mathematics, statistics, or related quantitative field.

official_definition: Designs and orchestrates cloud computing strategies, architectures, and infrastructure across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments.
tasks: formulates cloud migration roadmaps and architectural blueprints
evaluates cloud security, compliance, and disaster recovery capabilities
optimizes cloud resource utilization and cost management
coordinates with DevOps engineers to implement automated infrastructure
entry_qualifications: Degree in computing or engineering with professional cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).

official_definition: Implements continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines, automates infrastructure provisioning, and maintains platform reliability across development and production.
tasks: develops CI/CD pipeline automation scripts and release schedules
manages containerized platforms using Kubernetes and Docker
monitors platform performance, system availability, and latency
automates infrastructure provisioning through code
entry_qualifications: Degree or diploma in computing with experience in infrastructure automation and CI/CD tools.

official_definition: Designs, implements, and monitors cybersecurity strategies, protocols, and technical controls to safeguard digital infrastructure against malicious threats and vulnerabilities.
tasks: monitors network systems for anomalous activities and security events
performs threat modeling and vulnerability assessments
leads incident response and remediation during security emergencies
ensures compliance with Singapore Cybersecurity Act and international standards
entry_qualifications: Degree in cybersecurity, computer science, or equivalent professional certifications.

official_definition: Researches, analyzes and evaluates requirements for software applications and operating systems; designs, develops, tests and maintains software solutions to meet user requirements.
tasks: writes and codes software programs according to specifications
tests software programs to locate and correct errors
modifies and expands existing programs to meet operational demands
documents program design and operational instructions
entry_qualifications: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech / B.E.) or Master of Computer Applications (MCA).

official_definition: Researches, analyzes, and evaluates client business needs and operational requirements; formulates system technical specifications and architectural plans for information systems.
tasks: interviews users and analyzes business workflow procedures
develops system architecture diagrams and technical documentation
evaluates compatibility of software and hardware platforms
coordinates with developers to ensure system conformance
entry_qualifications: Degree in computer science, information technology, or business management with IT specialization.

official_definition: Designs, implements, configures, manages, and secures database management systems to guarantee high performance, security, and data recoverability.
tasks: creates and maintains database structures and access privileges
coordinates data backup, recovery procedures, and replication
tunes SQL queries and indexes to optimize performance
monitors database capacity and executes storage allocation
entry_qualifications: Degree in computing or database administration certifications.

official_definition: Software developers research, analyze and evaluate requirements for existing or new software applications and operating systems, and design, develop, test and maintain software solutions to meet these requirements.
tasks: researching, analyzing and evaluating requirements for software applications
designing, writing, testing, and debugging software programs
developing and maintaining technical documentation
entry_qualifications: University degree in computer science or related quantitative field.

official_definition: Systems analysts conduct research, analyze and evaluate client information technology requirements, procedures and problems, and develop and implement proposals, recommendations and plans for improvement.
tasks: consulting with users to define system requirements
identifying inefficiencies and proposing technological solutions
preparing technical proposals and system specifications
entry_qualifications: University degree in computer science, business systems, or related discipline.
